text:
Anna (PM): Quick sync on Priority Lane add-on — need launch criteria and blocking questions from eng/finance/legal before we commit to public docs.
Ben (Sales): customers asking if it’s per-seat or per-commit. most want per-commit + burst credits.
Dina (Finance): prefer per-token banded pricing + monthly min to avoid revenue churn. also need clear overage calc.
Charlie (Eng): tech-wise we can enforce routing + priority tokens, but we need to define soft vs hard caps and fair-use rules.
Eva (CSM): pilot customers (3–5) said they will adopt if SLA included and price predictable. they worry about noisy tenants using all priority.
Anna (PM): proposed: 2 tiers — Priority (soft cap + queued burst) and Priority+ (reserved lanes w/ SLA & commit). thoughts?
Ben (Sales): that maps to field asks. Pricing anchor for Priority+ should be enterprise commit tied. Priority can be add-on $/k tokens/month with a soft monthly cap.
Dina (Finance): we need rules for refunds/credits if we miss SLA. Also margin calc: reserved lanes mean fixed infra cost + allocation tag.
Charlie (Eng): implementation notes: we tag requests with priority flag, route to priority pool when available, otherwise fall back to best-effort. we can surface metrics per-customer (p95 latency, tokens served).
Anna (PM): Launch criteria checklist draft: 
```
- 3 pilot customers onboarded for at least 2 weeks
- SLA doc + credit policy approved by legal/finance
- Eng implements per-customer priority tagging + metrics
- Pricing page + console toggle/backfill UX ready
- E2E tests for fallback behavior and billing accuracy
```
Dina (Finance): add: internal cost model validated (unit economics at 50/75/100% utilization).
Frank (Legal): need clear ToS addendum for priority behavior, abuse policy, and data residency implications if routing across regions.
Eva (CSM): request adding a migration path for pilot customers to Priority+ without service interruption. customers asked for a simple toggle in console.
Charlie (Eng): console toggle is fine, but backend needs quota reconciliation job to move cached KV + billing markers. ETA ~2 sprints.
Anna (PM): risk register: 
- Hot path overload: priority pool saturated -> degraded customer experience
- Billing mismatch between tag and recorded usage
- Legal/regulatory on reserved lanes across regions
We should score these and set mitigation owners.
Ben (Sales): if we require monthly commit for Priority+, sales cycles get longer. need objection handling doc and a pilot discount template.
Dina (Finance): acceptable: 3-month minimum for Commitment, pro-rated monthly, 10% early-exit fee? open to suggestions.
Frank (Legal): 10% fee seems okay but need to verify with compliance for APAC customers.
Anna (PM): proposed owners: Eng -> Charlie, Finance -> Dina, Sales -> Ben, CS -> Eva, Legal -> Frank. Owner for rollout checklist: Anna.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for feature branch pr/4523 (priority-tagging) — status: CI running :gear:.
Charlie (Eng): I'll push to green before next sync. blockers: need a billing event schema change (two fields: priority_flag, priority_tier).
Dina (Finance): billing event schema change must include sample export for downstream analytics. add to acceptance criteria.
Anna (PM): next steps before exec buy-in: finalize pricing bands, sign-off on SLA & credits, pilot kickoff plan. aim for pilot kickoff next Tue.
Ben (Sales): I'll line up 2 committed pilots and share intro email templates.
Eva (CSM): I'll prep onboarding checklist and a short customer-facing FAQ about limits, failover behavior, and SLA credits.
Frank (Legal): I'll draft the addendum and ping compliance for APAC note.
Charlie (Eng): timeline estimate: priority tagging + metrics + console toggle = 4 weeks, billing schema + reconciliation = 2 weeks parallel. need one coordinated rollback plan.
Anna (PM): thanks — I'll update the product spec with these owners/criteria and circulate. ping @here when you’ve updated your docs. :raised_hands:
Ben (Sales): noted. will update the pilot deck.
Dina (Finance): will provide unit-cost spreadsheet by EOD Friday.
Eva (CSM): onboarding doc will be ready before pilot.
Frank (Legal): expect first draft in 3 business days.
Anna (PM): closing — if no major objections, I'll move this to the roadmap and create a dedicated JIRA epic with the checklist.
Charlie (Eng): no objections from eng side.
Ben (Sales): go for it. :thumbsup:
Anna (PM): great, thanks everyone.
